'''Repulsor-sticks''' were sporting equipment used in the [[trophy chase]], a sport played on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalos IV]]. Players used repulsor-sticks to guide an [[anti-grav ball]] through [[target-ring]]s suspended from stable [[neph]]s.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
